query:
SELECT
                        m.text,
                        u.username as sender_username,
                        u.first_name as sender_first_name,
                        u.is_bot,
                        m.sent_at
                    FROM messages m
                    JOIN users u ON m.sender_id = u.id
                    WHERE m.chat_id = $1
                      AND m.message_thread_id IS NULL
                      AND m.sent_at > $2
                    ORDER BY m.sent_at ASC
                    LIMIT $3
